mapper.select: select from ma_model_provider order by priority asc, created_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into ma_model_provider ( id, name, provider_type, routing_group, capabilities, base_url, api_key_ref, status, priority, timeout_ms, input_cost_per_1k_tokens, output_cost_per_1k_tokens, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{name}, #{providerType}, #{routingGroup}, #{capabilities}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKeyRef}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{timeoutMs}, #{inputCostPer1kTokens}, #{outputCostPer1kTokens}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) on conflict (id) do update set name = excluded.name, provider_type = excluded.provider_type, routing_group = excluded.routing_group, capabilities = excluded.capabilities, base_url = excluded.base_url, api_key_ref = excluded.api_key_ref, status = excluded.status, priority = excluded.priority, timeout_ms = excluded.timeout_ms, input_cost_per_1k_tokens = excluded.input_cost_per_1k_tokens, output_cost_per_1k_tokens = excluded.output_cost_per_1k_tokens, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
mapper.select: select from ma_prompt_template where prompt_key = #{promptKey} and status = 'ACTIVE' order by version desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ma_prompt_template ( id, prompt_key, name, version, content, status, change_note, high_risk, approval_status, approved_by, approved_at, approval_note, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{promptKey}, #{name}, #{version}, #{content}, #{status}, #{changeNote}, #{highRisk}, #{approvalStatus}, #{approvedBy}, #{approvedAt}, #{approvalNote}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) on conflict (id) do update set name = excluded.name, content = excluded.content, status = excluded.status, change_note = excluded.change_note, high_risk = excluded.high_risk, approval_status = excluded.approval_status, approved_by = excluded.approved_by, approved_at = excluded.approved_at, approval_note = excluded.approval_note, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
mapper.update: update ma_prompt_template set status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = now() where prompt_key = #{promptKey} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into ma_invocation_log ( id, project_id, application_id, environment_id, prompt_key, prompt_version, sensitivity_level, provider_id, provider_name, model_name, routing_rule_name, routing_group, model_capability, status, fallback_used, prompt_digest, request_preview, response_preview, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_cost, error_code, error_message, latency_ms, actor_service, delegated_user_id, created_at ) values ( #{id}, #{projectId}, #{applicationId}, #{environmentId}, #{promptKey}, #{promptVersion}, #{sensitivityLevel}, #{providerId}, #{providerName}, #{modelName}, #{routingRuleName}, #{routingGroup}, #{modelCapability}, #{status}, #{fallbackUsed}, #{promptDigest}, #{requestPreview}, #{responsePreview}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{totalCost}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{latencyMs}, #{actorService}, #{delegatedUserId}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select:
select from ma_invocation_log
order by created_at desc limit #{query.size} offset #{query.offset}

select count(*) as total, count(*) filter (where status = 'SUCCEEDED') as succeeded, count(*) filter (where status = 'FAILED') as failed, count(*) filter (where status = 'BLOCKED') as blocked, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) as input_tokens, coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) as output_tokens, coalesce(sum(total_cost), 0) as total_cost from ma_invocation_log
mapper.insert: insert into ma_invocation_job ( job_id, status, request_json, actor_service, delegated_user_id, trace_id, created_at, started_at, finished_at, invocation_id, error_code, error_message, response_json ) values ( #{jobId}, #{status}, cast(#{requestJson} as jsonb), #{actorService}, #{delegatedUserId}, #{traceId}, #{createdAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{invocationId}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, cast(#{responseJson} as jsonb) )
mapper.select: select from ma_invocation_job where invocation_id = #{invocationId} order by created_at desc limit 1
select from ma_invocation_job where status = 'QUEUED' order by created_at asc
mapper.update: update ma_invocation_job set status = 'RUNNING', started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = null, error_code = null, error_message = null, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 where job_id = #{jobId} and status = 'QUEUED'

update ma_invocation_job set status = 'SUCCEEDED', finished_at = #{finishedAt}, invocation_id = #{invocationId}, error_code = null, error_message = null, response_json = cast(#{responseJson} as jsonb), updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 where job_id = #{jobId}

update ma_invocation_job set status = 'FAILED', finished_at = #{finishedAt}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 where job_id = #{jobId} and status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')

update ma_invocation_job set status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = #{finishedAt}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 where job_id = #{jobId} and status = 'QUEUED'
update ma_invocation_job set error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 where job_id = #{jobId} and status = 'RUNNING'

update ma_invocation_job set status = 'FAILED', finished_at = #{finishedAt}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 where status = 'RUNNING' and updated_at < #{staleBefore}
